external_review_evidence.ttg_observable_interpretation: TTG reports a quasi-temperature difference associated with collective phonon energy; it is not an automatic identity with equilibrium temperature or UET Phi.
external_review_evidence.standard_comparator_note: The source reports comparison with full-scattering-matrix phonon Boltzmann transport without fitted parameters in the reported simulation comparison.
external_review_evidence.uet_mapping_consequence: The admissible target is a source-specific Delta_Tq or normalized y_TTG measurement operator; alpha_Phi_K remains an independent calibration or derivation gate.
